observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Covered outdoor porch or patio with wooden flooring and ocean views in the background
observation.dancers: Mixed group of young adults and instructors; starts with a small group of three, expands to a larger group of teenagers/students dancing together
observation.formation_and_space: Initially in a loose line/group, transitioning to a circle, paired couples, and individual movements across the floor space
observation.posture: Upright torso with slightly bent knees and relaxed weight transfer
observation.footwork: Stepping side to side, heel digs and toe taps, walking steps synchronized to the rhythm; exact weight shifts occluded by shoes and camera cuts
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held loosely by the sides, hands on hips, hands joined in a circle, or holding partner hands in social dance holds
observation.hips_and_torso: Natural movement of torso and hips following the stepping rhythm, with some casual leaning and turning
observation.partnering: Social dance holds in pairs as well as solo and circle group formations
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Standing level throughout, occasional small turns and stepping pivots
observation.costume_and_props: Casual everyday clothing including t-shirts, shorts, skirts, and trousers; some barefoot and some wearing sneakers or sandals
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placements and rapid weight transfers are partially obscured by footwear, camera angles, and wide group shots.

signature_moments.what: Stepping forward with heel digs and pointing the toe while keeping a bouncing knee action
Group standing with hands on hips performing side-to-side rhythmic steps
Couples holding hands in closed social dance position and stepping in tandem
Large group holding hands in a circle and moving side to side together
